$comment: STDWATCH-1 (OKF-V02-STANDARDS-WATCH-BUILD-SPEC.md §5). Watch list is deliberately small: nearly every standard SPEC.md cites is immutable-by-construction (dated/versioned URI) and needs no watching (§5.1). Entries here are for standards that republish IN PLACE at an undated URL, where pinning alone hides drift. Checked by scripts/check-standards-drift.mjs via the weekly standards-watch.yml cron. Never a deploy gate (§5.3 inv.1). On drift: open a GitHub issue, never auto-bump pinned_digest (§5.3 inv.3).

entries.notes: Republishes in place at main (no version tag) — the URL we consume IS the undated latest pointer, so url and latest_pointer are the same target by construction. pinned_digest = SHA-256 of okf/SPEC.md raw bytes. re-pinned 2026-10-23 to upstream 62432a09 (2026-08-21: ISO 8601 datetimes for timestamps); the bundle generator still emits date-only timestamps (deferred, Tim 2026-10-23). OCG companion bundle only (repo/chaingraph/okf/); no execution_hash impact (SPEC.md §10 firewall).
